title: Wild Frontiers
description: A Vanilla Plus Modpack with a difficult survival twist! Made for Fabric and built on Minecraft's modern updates!
body:
A Vanilla Plus style modpack designed to challenge you, break you, but ultimately create a long-lasting, fun survival experience. Made for the newest Fabric versions of Minecraft, and only using mods that will be regularly updated and maintained. This Modpack does not stray from Minecraft's core gameplay. Instead, it creates a punishing start and more dynamic survival features. Some core mods are: Serene Seasons, Frostiful, Scorchful, Leveled Mobs, Mutant Mobs, and many, many more. 

If you want to play an RPG-style Minecraft modpack with brutal survival elements, thrilling structures to explore, and scary and powerful mobs to face, then Wild Frontiers is for you! It is also multiplayer-friendly and comes with all the optimization mods required to run a smooth modded server with friends! Or go it alone and enjoy the expanded world, structures, and unique challenges. 

And don't worry, for every punishing feature, there are well-earned moments of peace! Mods like Civillis will make sure mobs don't knock down your door every night as long as you keep building your settlement. Click Villagers and Villager Guards will help make villages more comfortable and safe....just don't steal from them...and if you really want to overcome the frontier...perhaps dark powers are awaiting you from the Nycto mod! 

This modpack will be regularly updated, sometimes adding new mods and, in rare cases, removing mods that are outdated or not meeting quality standards. So take caution when updating to the newest version. Keep in mind that every version will be tested heavily before release to reduce bugs. So you can be confident knowing that this modpack will never crash your game or not run as intended! 

GOOD LUCK OUT IN THE FRONTIER!
